title: Republicans, Facing Midterm Peril, Try to Brand Democrats as Communists
summary: Communism, in the president’s hyperbolic telling, is a graver threat to the country than the Pearl Harbor or 9/11 attacks were. Whether this midterm strategy works is an open question.
